entities.summary: Jehnny Beth is a French musician and actress originally from Poitiers and based in London, England since 2006 and also in Paris. She came to notability within Europe as one half of the indie rock duo John & Jehn, and globally as frontwoman of the English post-punk revival band Savages. Her debut solo album To Love Is to Live was released to critical acclaim in June 2020. She has also collaborated with other artists such as Trentemøller, Julian Casablancas, Tindersticks, Gorillaz, Noel Gallagher, Romy Madley Croft of the xx, Idles and Bobby Gillespie of Primal Scream.
